mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at the Verona Public Library with an air quality index of 63, which is in the moderate range, so please keep that in mind while you are out and about today.

City officials are busy with the upcoming September 8th Plan Commission meeting where they will review projects such as the site plan for 201 South Main Street and an initial review for the Sub-Zero project in Liberty Business Park.

It is a busy couple of days for our community. Today, you can join trivia at either Hop Haus or Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, there is even more to choose from with yoga at Insight Wellness, the downtown farmer's market, and trivia nights at The Mill and the Bogey Factory.
In our weekly police report, officers noted that on August 8, a drone pilot from the department assisted the Dane County Sheriff's office by tracking a suspect vehicle that fled into a corn field.

Today's delicious flavor is Chocolate Heath Crunch. Since they are currently closed, you can plan to head over when they open at 10 AM. If you are looking for tomorrow's treat, they will be serving Chocolate Covered Strawberry.
